messages:
Amir (AE): Quick sync — customer wants a 3-week pilot. Need alignment on success criteria: latency, cost, and quality thresholds before we hand to Solutions.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): Echo. Can you share the primary use case + sample prompts? That lets us pick model variant and metrics.
Amir (AE): Use case = contextual FAQ + guided responses for onboarding flows. Sample prompts attached in the GH gist: https://gist.github.com/example. Timeline: kickoff Monday => 3 weeks to acceptance.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): Ok. Proposal for acceptance criteria:
- Functional: end-to-end responses cover NLU intent + slot extraction for 95% of 500 eval prompts
- Quality: automated eval accuracy >= 90% on the provided eval set; manual spot check pass rate >= 92%
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms for single-turn queries in hosted region EU-west
- Cost: average token cost <= $0.25 / 1k tokens over the test workload
- Stability: error rate < 1% during a 24h peak sim
Jordan (Prod Eng): Notes: p95 200ms is doable on medium models with batching disabled for single-turn. If they need <150ms we should recommend Dedicated with reserved GPUs or quantized model.
Evan (SRE): Also call out warm KV cache for multi-turn flows — that reduces p50 by ~30%.
Asha (Security): Quick Q on data handling: will any PII be stored? They said user emails may be in contexts. Need to confirm retention and whether customer needs on-prem/private deployment for compliance.
Amir (AE): They prefer hosted but will sign an NDA. If needed, they asked about VPC/private for production. For pilot they can use hosted with data scrubbed.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): For the pilot I recommend: hosted sandbox + one dedicated reserved slot for stress tests. Plan by week:
- Week 0 (kickoff): ingest dataset, wire auth, create eval set
- Week 1: baseline run (hosted), measure metrics
- Week 2: optimize prompts, enable caching/quantization suggestions
- Week 3: acceptance runs + handover
Jordan (Prod Eng): Pricing question from customer — they asked cost delta between hosted metered vs Dedicated reserved. Short answer: hosted metered is pay-as-you-go; Dedicated gives predictable throughput with commit discounts. Tell them rough: hosted POC ~$X/week depending on tokens, Dedicated needs a minimum monthly commit (we can provide an eval credit offset for POC).
Amir (AE): Can you prepare a simple slide: "POC cost scenarios: hosted vs Dedicated"? They want to show procurement.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): Will do. Also we need the exact eval script. Suggest `eval/run_eval.sh --prompts evals.csv --model rdx-medium --warm-cache` — we'll share.
Evan (SRE): For acceptance load test, we'll run `wrk` for 30m @ 100 RPS to validate autoscaling and p95. Note: autoscale policies for hosted can't exceed account quotas; may need temporary quota bump.
Asha (Security): Support items from my side:
- Confirmed SOC2 scope: we can provide SOC2 report
- SSO via SAML available for Dedicated/private only; hosted supports OAuth/SSO federation in enterprise tier
- Data at rest encryption: supported
Please send the security questionnaire to me, I'll pre-fill common answers.
Amir (AE): Forwarding the vendor security questionnaire now.
POC-bot: Uploaded: vendor-questionnaire.pdf
Sophia (Solutions Eng): Acceptance thresholds to record in the SOW (so procurement is clear):
- Quality: automated accuracy >= 90% AND manual review pass >= 92%
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms (hosted target), p95 <= 150ms (if they choose Dedicated)
- Cost: no more than $0.30 / 1k tokens averaged over pilot (we'll try to hit $0.20)
- Hallucination: <= 3% measured by manual sample checks
- Availability: 99.5% during pilot window
Amir (AE): Customer OK with those, requests a short checklist for sign-off.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): I'll produce a 1-page sign-off checklist with tests + commands to reproduce. Example entries:
- Run `eval/run_eval.sh` -> output `results.json` -> accuracy >= 90%
- Run `wrk -t2 -c50 -d30s <endpoint>` -> collect p95
- Spot-check 50 responses for hallucination
Jordan (Prod Eng): Action items for engineering:
- Provide temporary quota bump for RPS test (Evan)
- Export model variant and quantization config used for baseline (Sophia/Jordan)
Evan (SRE): I'll file the quota request today.
Asha (Security): I'll draft answers for the security questionnaire and flag any blockers (e.g., on-prem requirement) within 48h.
Amir (AE): Great. Last ask from customer: can we provide an estimated runway to production after pilot if accepted? They want a 6–8 week plan.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): Yes — post-pilot plan: 2 weeks for hardening + SLA + SSO + infra prep, 4 weeks for integration and phased rollout. We'll include that in the SOW.
Amir (AE): Perfect. Thanks team. I'll update the customer and schedule kickoff for Monday 09:00 CET.
Sophia (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll attach the eval scripts and the sign-off checklist before EOD Friday.
Jordan (Prod Eng): Noted.
Evan (SRE): On it.
Asha (Security): Will share questionnaire draft.
Amir (AE): Closing loop — cc @customer-contact once we have SOW draft.
